messages:
Ravi (Support): Heads up 11 We have a customer ticket: Ventra Labs (acct VENT-77) was supposed to get a $1,250 promo credit but it landed on VENT-099 instead. Invoice INV-2026-5197 shows -1250.00 on VENT-099. Partner wants the credit moved to VENT-77 (credit to next invoice).

Tara (Finance Ops): Can you paste the invoice line and any payment or promo external_id? Need to check if this was auto-applied during recon.

Ravi (Support): External promo id: promo_apr_v2_vent. Invoice snippet below.
```
INV-2026-5197 | VENT-099 | Promo Credit | PROMO_APR_V2 | -1250.00 | USD
INV-2026-5197 | VENT-077 | Usage | API | 1250.00 | USD
```
Link (internal): https://redwood.internal/fin/snap/INV-5197

AdjustBot: reconciliation-run-2026-04-16 matched promo_apr_v2_vent -> org VENT-099 (mapping override).

Joel (Billing): Looks like a mapping override from a legacy merge. Plan: 1) reverse the misapplied credit line on VENT-099, 2) post a manual credit on VENT-077 for $1,250.00 with memo. Need GL code and approval.

Tara (Finance Ops): Tax = 0. Use GL 7550-PartnerCredits. We'll treat this as a manual billing adjustment (non-cash). Nadia, can you approve?

Nadia (CFO): Approved up to $2,000 for manual credits related to system misrouting. Use GL 7550-PartnerCredits and create JV to reverse any recognized revenue if invoice already closed. :white_check_mark:

Priya (Revenue Ops): Quick check 1 If revenue was recognized for INV-2026-5197 (period 2026-03), we need JV-ADJ-5197 to reverse the recognized revenue. Tara, please flag revenue ops when you post the journal.

Tara (Finance Ops): Will do. I'll create JV-ADJ-5197 and tag Priya. Joel, can you add a partner-facing note: "Credit issued due to promo misapplication; ref INV-2026-5197; credit applied to next invoice; no refund"?

Hector (Acct Exec): Partner asked for a confirmation email we can forward to procurement. That note is perfect. Also they'd like an ETA for the correction. Can we commit to showing it on next invoice cycle (May 1)?

Joel (Billing): Yes, we'll queue the manual credit (MC-5197) today. It will appear on their next statement (cycle date 2026-05-01). Added internal ticket BILL-3033 to update promo->org mapping logic to avoid misrouting.

Tara (Finance Ops): Actions: created manual credit MC-5197 for VENT-077, amount $1,250.00, GL 7550-PartnerCredits; JV-ADJ-5197 queued; notified revenue ops; filed BILL-3033.

Ravi (Support): Thanks all. I'll reply to the partner with the confirmation language and ETA. Marking support case pending partner acknowledgement. :thumbsup:

Nadia (CFO): Good ops. Please add this scenario to the monthly billing runbook so we have clear steps next time.
